title: verdict.reason@1
description: The one source of the reasons the core gives a verdict of its own, beside what its checks showed: the project isn't trusted, a target no longer resolves, a threshold has no unit, items its task left open, an option you switched to, a call DeepBuild denied that ran anyway, or checks that didn't start. Every view that shows one says it in words (contracts' code-words.json), never as the code.

x-closure.closed: the reasons the core gives a verdict of its own, beside its checks' results; a reader at an earlier minor reads one it doesn't know as unknown
x-closure.reopens: a minor that adds a member; a reader at the earlier minor takes it for unknown
